$comment: THEME REFERENCE — documentation of all colors used in colorConfig.css. This file is for reference only; the actual CSS variables live in /src/styles/colorConfig.css. Edit colors there, not here.
name: Best Car Accessories — Dark Automotive
description: Pure black luxury automotive aesthetic with vibrant red accent. Inspired by premium auto-works showroom design.

brand.name: Best Car Accessories
brand.accentMeaning: Power, action, urgency — used sparingly for maximum impact on CTAs and key highlights

primary.name: brand-red
primary.use: Primary buttons, CTAs, section labels, accent borders

hover.name: brand-red-hover
hover.use: Hover states for primary buttons and links

soft.name: brand-red-soft
soft.use: Subtle red highlights, soft accent text

typography.rationale: Geometric, squared, sharp corners — signals precision, clean finishes, engineering quality. Same Eurostile/Microgramma genre as Michroma but with 6 weights (400–900) for full hierarchy flexibility. Free on Google Fonts.

scale.$comment: INTENTIONAL 7-step scale. Every size has one job. Don't pick outside this list.

caption.use: Section labels (UPPER), captions, small UI text

lead.use: Lead paragraph, large body, hero descriptions

title.use: H4 — card titles, sidebar titles, small section titles

display.use: H2 — page titles, big section headings

uiPrinciples.sparinglyAccent: Use red sparingly. Too much red dilutes its impact. Limit to: CTAs, section labels, one word per headline.
uiPrinciples.generousWhitespace: Give content room to breathe. Sections should have substantial vertical padding.
uiPrinciples.strongHierarchy: Primary white headlines → secondary gray body → muted captions. Use weight + size + color together.
uiPrinciples.accessibleContrast: All text meets WCAG AA: white on black = 21:1 ratio.
